6.en: The payment system records each transaction automatically.
6.zh: 付款系统会自动记录每笔交易。

7.en: The bank transferred the money to her account the next day.
7.zh: 第二天，银行把钱转到了她的账户。

9.en: The instructions are transparent and easy to follow.
9.zh: 说明内容清晰易懂，照着做就可以。

14.en: The police used a phone signal to trace the missing hiker.
14.zh: 警方利用手机信号追踪失踪的徒步者。

18.en: The satellite entered orbit around Earth.
18.zh: 卫星进入了绕地球运行的轨道。

23.en: A short walk can boost your energy in the afternoon.
23.zh: 下午短暂散步能让你恢复精神。

28.en: She reaped the benefits of years of practice.
28.zh: 多年的练习让她收获了成果。

30.en: This farm yields enough vegetables for the local market.
30.zh: 这个农场产出的蔬菜足以供应当地市场。

33.en: The town depends on irrigation during the dry season.
33.zh: 旱季时，这座小镇依靠灌溉供水。

34.en: One large company does not dominate the local market.
34.zh: 一家大公司并未控制当地市场。

37.en: We take turns doing household chores.

43.en: The team added three new items to the meeting agenda.
43.zh: 团队在会议议程中新增了三个事项。

44.en: A short evening routine helps her relax before bed.
44.zh: 简短的晚间惯例能帮助她睡前放松。
